intent: Add passive, privacy-safe provider usage telemetry while preserving enrichment behavior. Prove true translator, classifier, cycle, and headline transport call chains with fake providers and exact run/batch correlation.

resolved_findings.title: Structured telemetry was discarded by the default Render formatter
resolved_findings.resolution: emit_attempt now renders the allowlisted event as safe JSON in the message while retaining LogRecord extra metadata. A plain StreamHandler StringIO regression parses the rendered line and checks privacy and nullable usage.
resolved_findings.verification: Focused Stage 0 suite passed after the fix.

resolved_findings.title: Cycle proof bypassed the actual direct HTTP response extractor
resolved_findings.resolution: The CycleRunner test now keeps both real factories and x_monitor.attribution.AnthropicClaudeClient and fakes only http.client.HTTPSConnection. A separate malformed-assistant-JSON case proves provider usage survives the real response extractor.
resolved_findings.verification: Focused Stage 0 suite passed after the fix.

resolved_findings.title: Staging events reported an unknown provider host class
resolved_findings.resolution: Provider class now derives from each configured client or headline URL through an exact allowlist for api.deepseek.com, api.minimax.io, and api.anthropic.com. Unsupported, spoofed, malformed, or throwing accessors return unknown without exposing URLs or changing provider behavior. Cycle overrides were removed so translator, classifier, relevancy, and headline events use their actual configured route.
resolved_findings.verification: Provider-free tests cover the helper's exact allowlist, spoofed and malformed hosts, throwing accessors, custom-host privacy, and real CycleRunner direct-HTTP factory events. Code inspection confirmed the legacy SDK accessor plus relevancy and headline propagation; broader existing privacy tests cover credential exclusion.

dismissed_findings.title: Headline unavailable usage is converted to zero
dismissed_findings.reason: The headline ledger's integer defaults and zero coercion predate Stage 0. The new telemetry event correctly preserves missing provider usage as null, now covered by an event-only regression. No source or schema change is required in this scoped release.
